d: Company Description Direct Freight Solutions is a leading provider of customer-driven freight services in the region, offering tailored import and export solutions by land, sea, and air since 2004. Headquartered in Jordan, the company delivers comprehensive logistics support including brokerage, warehousing, and distribution, acting as an extension of customers’ business teams to ensure reliable and timely shipments. With a global network of offices and local employees in key markets, Direct Freight Solutions manages transport complexities and maintains clear communication with shippers and consignees in their own languages and time zones. The company is built on standards of honesty and integrity, focusing on professional, efficient freight management to create successful and satisfied customers. Its mission is to provide flexible, reliable, and cost-effective forwarding and logistics services through a worldwide network.

Role Description The Sea Freight Operation & Pricing Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Muscat, responsible for managing end-to-end sea freight operations and pricing activities. This position coordinates shipments with carriers, shipping lines, and customers, prepares and reviews documentation, monitors cargo movement, and resolves operational issues to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery. The specialist analyzes market rates, negotiates with vendors, prepares competitive quotations, and updates pricing structures in line with company policies and customer requirements. Daily tasks include close collaboration with internal teams and overseas offices, maintaining accurate records in logistics systems, tracking shipments, and providing proactive status updates to clients. The role also involves supporting continuous improvement in operational processes, maintaining compliance with regulations, and contributing to customer-focused solutions in line with Direct Freight’s service standards.
q: Candidates should possess strong sea freight operations skills, including shipment coordination, documentation handling, scheduling, and cargo tracking.
Candidates should possess pricing and commercial skills such as rate analysis, quotation preparation, vendor negotiation, and margin management.
Candidates should possess customer service and communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, client relationship management, and issue resolution.
Candidates should possess organizational and analytical skills, such as attention to detail, data analysis, problem-solving, and time management.
Candidates should possess proficiency in logistics and office software, including MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and relevant freight or ERP systems.
Relevant experience in sea freight, shipping, or logistics operations, preferably with international freight forwarding, is highly beneficial.
A diploma or bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, business, or a related field is preferred.
Knowledge of international trade regulations, Incoterms, and customs procedures, along with the ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural environment, will be advantageous.
